title: Colonial Office correspondence on the War of the Golden Stool
caption_en: British Colonial Office papers document the 1900 conflict over the Golden Stool and the exile of Ashanti leaders, including Yaa Asantewaa.
provenance_en: The National Archives (United Kingdom), Colonial Office records (CO 96). Cross-referenced in persona dossier src-yaa-co-1900; catalogue detail held off-repo per licence review.
